title: Pure Ryzeal
summary: Ryzeal cards with a full set of generic hand traps, staples and Rank 4s. The page's combo lines add Mulcharmy cards, Maxx "C", Pot of Desires and Seventh Tachyon, so they use cards this list leaves out. Ice, Sword and Ext Ryzeal and Ryzeal Detonator are capped by the banlist, so the 2025 cards carry more weight: Star Ryzeal summons itself by detaching a material and Sets a Ryzeal Spell/Trap, and Mass Driver pumps the Ryzeals and attaches itself as material. Almost every Ryzeal summon locks the Extra Deck to Rank 4 Xyz Monsters, so the Extra Deck is all Rank 4.
main: Ice Ryzeal
Semi-Limited. Normal Summoned: summons another Ryzeal from the Deck.
Sword Ryzeal
Semi-Limited. Summons itself next to a Ryzeal; summoned, searches a LIGHT Pyro.
Ext Ryzeal
Limited. Sends an Xyz from the Extra Deck to summon itself; summoned, searches a FIRE Thunder.
Star Ryzeal
Newest support. Detaches a material to summon itself, then Sets a Ryzeal Spell/Trap from the Deck.
Node Ryzeal
Summons itself with an Xyz in your field or GY; revives a Ryzeal.
Palm Ryzeal
Shuffles a Ryzeal back to summon itself; a Level 4 body for the Rank 4s.
Ryzeal Cross
Field Spell: negates an opposing monster effect with a Ryzeal Xyz material, and recycles two Ryzeals for a draw.
Ryzeal Plugin
Quick-Play: revives an Xyz or Ryzeal and attaches a Ryzeal from the Deck.
Ryzeal Mass Driver
Newest support. +1000 ATK to your Ryzeals and attaches itself to a Rank 4; from the hand to the GY, banishes a card from their GY.
Ryzeal Plasma Hole
Destroys a face-up card per Ryzeal Xyz; from the GY, Xyz Summons on the spot.
